plan.headline: Building toward kickoff Thu 7:15 PM CT. 2,448 contracts sold, 3,369 resting. Worst line -$171 (goal -$150 by kickoff).
plan.confidence_note: Every step below is a timer or rule in the bot's settings, and the bot is healthy. Nothing needs you.

sections.title: Right now
lines: Pregame build. Kickoff Thu 7:15 PM CT (in 19h 35m).
Sold 2,448 contracts so far. 3,369 more are resting on the book, on 6 of 6 sides.
By team: DEN 1,149, SEA 1,299.
Not balanced yet: the worst line is -$171; the goal is -$150 or better by kickoff, so $21 to close.
If every resting order filled, the worst line would be -$84.
Backstop (-$600) is not triggered; the loss cap is -$300.
Bot is healthy: heartbeat 21s old, no errors.

sections.title: Lagging sides
lines: DEN by 15+: sold 200, 443 behind the leader. Cheapest row is 10c, fair 9.1c. It can step down 1c at a time, to no lower than about 6.1c (never under the crowd's clearing price or fair minus 3c), after 20 min with no fill, at most one step per 15 min. Last price step: 10h 14m ago. Next possible step now, if nothing has filled.

SEA by 7-14: sold 222, 420 behind the leader. Cheapest row is 21c, crowd has been buying at 20c, fair 18.9c. It can step down 1c at a time, to no lower than about 20c (never under the crowd's clearing price or fair minus 3c), after 20 min with no fill, at most one step per 15 min. Last price step: 5m ago. Next possible step in 10m, if nothing has filled. Last hold reason (5m ago): filling one more row in full would push the worst line to -$171, so the bot holds its price.

DEN by 7-14: sold 307, 336 behind the leader. Cheapest row is 15c, fair 14.4c. It can step down 1c at a time, to no lower than about 11.4c (never under the crowd's clearing price or fair minus 3c), after 20 min with no fill, at most one step per 15 min. Last price step: 9h 1m ago. Next possible step now, if nothing has filled.

SEA by 15+: sold 450, 193 behind the leader. Cheapest row is 19c, crowd has been buying at 17c, fair 15.1c. It can step down 1c at a time, to no lower than about 17c (never under the crowd's clearing price or fair minus 3c), after 20 min with no fill, at most one step per 15 min. Last price step: 18m ago. Next possible step now, if nothing has filled. Last hold reason (18m ago): filling one more row in full would push the worst line to -$171, so the bot holds its price.

The bot looks at lagging sides every loop (1m) and takes a fresh market snapshot about every 10 min (last one 25s ago). Rows already resting are not repriced when the sportsbook line moves; only new rows use the fresh fair.
A step is skipped if filling the new row in full would push the worst line lower.

sections.title: Next wave of contracts
lines: A side gets a new batch when its resting drops under 25% of what it launched with. The batch is 50% of the launch size (a third inside T-30), split 60/25/15 at +0/+1/+2c, priced from the last hour's fills.
Closest to triggering: SEA by 7-14 with 827 resting against a trigger of 225 (launch 900). That is far from the trigger.
The worst-line gate is open (-$171 is at or better than -$200), so a thin side would get a batch on the next loop.
Limits: up to 3 batches per side, 20 minutes apart, until T-3. Batches used so far: none.
A lagging side with nothing resting would get a catch-up batch sized to its gap. None is empty now.
Held back and not yet posted: DEN by 7-14: 53 contracts. The bot releases these when the batch cap and cash allow; I cannot see the exact moment.

sections.title: Tightening
lines: Trickle balancing (paid) starts at T-240: Thu 3:15 PM CT (in 15h 35m). The bot notes the worst line then, and walks it in a straight line to -$150 by T-10 (Thu 7:05 PM CT).
Rules: checks every 5 min, pays only when more than $25 behind the path, never on the most-held side, clips of up to 100 contracts, no more than $100 total paid per book. Spent so far: $0.
From T-30 (Thu 6:45 PM CT): if the worst line is -$150 or better, paid balancing stops for good; new offers keep going until kickoff.
Checkpoints (a market snapshot is logged each time): T-240, T-180, T-120, T-90, T-60, T-30.
At kickoff (Thu 7:15 PM CT) the in-game engine takes over and keeps the resting orders.

sections.title: Will it adapt on its own?
lines: Yes, on its own: lagging sides step their price down within the limits above; thin sides get new batches while the worst-line gate is open; paid balancing follows the timer.
No, it will not: reprice rows that are already resting when the sportsbook line moves, react to injury news, or cut a side that is selling fast. Check the line yourself on Wed/Thu if news breaks.

The one thing that depends on the crowd: the worst line is -$171 against a -$150 goal. Fills on the lagging sides lift it for free; if they do not come, the paid trickle covers the rest from T-240, up to $100.
I only read the bot's settings, state and log. I cannot see its next decision, only the rules it follows.
